values: 召唤皇家近卫并使其分摊伤害保护友军。
Peggy summons royal guards and has them take damage for allies.

被动地，战斗开始时，佩吉召唤2名“皇家近卫”加入战斗，“皇家近卫”继承佩吉120% + 16%的生命值和50% + 7%的攻击力。若佩吉被击败，全部卫兵会立刻撤离战场。
主动释放时：佩吉吹响号角，使在场的“皇家近卫”立刻回复相当于其最大生命值的生命，保护场上所有友军持续12秒，持续时间内使“皇家近卫”受到的生命损耗降低75%，并且所有友军受到的伤害的70%平均分摊给所有存活的“皇家近卫”。若此时场上存活的“皇家近卫”近卫低于2名则召唤一名新的“皇家近卫”加入战斗。

Passive. When a battle starts, Peggy summons 2 royal guards to join the fray. The royal guards inherit 120% + 16% of Peggy's HP and 50% + 7% of her ATK. If Peggy is defeated, all royal guards immediately leave the battlefield.
Active. Peggy blows her horn, instantly healing all remaining royal guards for an amount equal to their max HP. If there are fewer than 2 guards remaining, she summons a new royal guard to the battlefield. Peggy then orders these royal guards to protect all allies for 12s. During this time, 70% of the damage taken by all allies is shared evenly among the guards, while the guards' own HP loss is reduced by 75%.
“皇家近卫”继承的生命值提升至佩吉的130% + 16%，攻击力提升至佩吉的55% + 7%。
The royal guards inherit 130% + 16% of Peggy's HP and 55% + 7% of her ATK.
“皇家近卫”继承的生命值提升至佩吉的140% + 16%，攻击力提升至佩吉的60% + 7%。
The royal guards inherit 140% + 16% of Peggy's HP and 60% + 7% of her ATK.
“皇家近卫”继承的生命值提升至佩吉的150% + 16%，攻击力提升至佩吉的65% + 7%。
The royal guards inherit 150% + 16% of Peggy's HP and 65% + 7% of her ATK.
“皇家近卫”继承的生命值提升至佩吉的160% + 16%，攻击力提升至佩吉的70% + 7%。
The royal guards inherit 160% + 16% of Peggy's HP and 70% + 7% of her ATK.
为皇家近卫和队友回复生命值。
Peggy restores HP to royal guards and allies.
佩吉展开魔法卷轴，对自己在场的全部“皇家近卫”，以及其余2名最虚弱的友军每秒回复佩吉150% + 18% ATK的生命值，持续8秒。
Peggy opens a magic scroll, healing all of her remaining royal guards and 2 other weakest allies for Peggy's 150% + 18% ATK HP per second for 8s.
每秒回复的生命值提升至160% + 18% ATK。
Increases the HP restored per second to 160% + 18% ATK.
每秒回复的生命值提升至170% + 18% ATK。
Increases the HP restored per second to 170% + 18% ATK.
每秒回复的生命值提升至180% + 18% ATK。
Increases the HP restored per second to 180% + 18% ATK.
召唤皇家射手并使其射出破甲箭，使敌人受到的远程伤害提高。
Peggy summons a royal marksman to fire armor-piercing arrows, increasing the ranged damage taken by the affected enemies.
佩吉在战场后方召唤出一名“皇家射手”帮助战斗。“皇家射手”继承佩吉100%的攻击力，并且会射出3轮破甲箭对最靠前的2名敌人造成200% + 20% ATK伤害。被破甲箭命中的目标在接下来的5秒内受到的远程伤害提高22% + 3%，持续时间内己方召唤物对目标造成的远程伤害额外提高14% + 2%。

Peggy summons a royal marksman in the backline to assist in battle. The marksman inherits 100% of Peggy's ATK and fires 3 volleys of armor-piercing arrows, dealing 200% + 20% ATK damage to 2 frontmost enemies. Enemies hit by the armor-piercing arrows take 22% + 3% more ranged damage for the next 5s. During this time, allied summons' ranged damage against the affected enemies is increased by an extra 14% + 2%.
被破甲箭命中的目标受到的远程伤害提高的数值提升至23% + 3%，己方召唤物对目标造成的远程伤害额外提高的数值提升至16% + 2%。
The extra ranged damage dealt to enemies hit by armor-piercing arrows is increased to 23% + 3%. For allied summons, their additional ranged damage against these enemies is increased to 16% + 2%.
被破甲箭命中的目标受到的远程伤害提高的数值提升至24% + 3%，己方召唤物对目标造成的远程伤害额外提高的数值提升至18% + 2%。
The extra ranged damage dealt to enemies hit by armor-piercing arrows is increased to 24% + 3%. For allied summons, their additional ranged damage against these enemies is increased to 18% + 2%.
被破甲箭命中的目标受到的远程伤害提高的数值提升至25% + 3%，己方召唤物对目标造成的远程伤害额外提高的数值提升至20% + 2%。
The extra ranged damage dealt to enemies hit by armor-piercing arrows is increased to 25% + 3%. For allied summons, their additional ranged damage against these enemies is increased to 20% + 2%.
急速提升10点，当有2个“皇家近卫”在场时急速额外提升5点。
Increases Haste by 10. If 2 royal guards are on the battlefield, further increases Haste by 5.
急速提升12点，当有2个“皇家近卫”在场时急速额外提升8点。
Increases Haste by 12. If 2 royal guards are on the battlefield, further increases Haste by 8.
急速提升15点，当有2个“皇家近卫”在场时急速额外提升10点。
Increases Haste by 15. If 2 royal guards are on the battlefield, further increases Haste by 10.
在海螺号角持续期间内增强皇家近卫。
Royal guards are enhanced while Princess' Rally is active.
在“海螺号角”持续期间内，“皇家近卫”可以在普通攻击期间交替使用皇室剑技：对周围1格的全部敌人造成200% ATK伤害，并为自身添加相当于80%实际伤害量的永久护盾。

The royal guards can alternate between normal attacks and royal sword moves while Princess' Rally is active, dealing 200% ATK damage to all enemies within 1 tile and gaining a permanent shield equal to 80% of the actual damage dealt.
皇室剑技造成的伤害提升至240% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by royal sword moves to 240% ATK.
“皇家近卫”携带半径1格的荣耀光环：处于光环内的其余所有友军造成的近距离伤害提升30%，己方召唤物造成的近距离伤害额外提升25%。
The royal guards gain a 1-tile glory aura. All other allies within the aura deal 30% more melee damage; this melee damage bonus is increased by an extra 25% for allied summons.
皇室剑技造成的伤害提升至280% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt by royal sword moves to 280% ATK.
在我方有多个友方召唤物时提升所有召唤物的攻击，护甲和魔抗。
Peggy increases all allied summons' ATK and Phys & Magic DEF when multiple allied summons are on the battlefield.
己方同时存活3个及以上来自不同友军的友方召唤物时，使我方全体召唤物提高相当于佩吉30%初始攻击力和40%初始护甲和魔抗。

When 3 or more allied summons from different allies are alive at the same time, all allied summons gain ATK equal to 30% of Peggy's initial ATK, and Phys & Magic DEF equal to 40% of Peggy's initial Phys & Magic DEF.
